# Intake Checklist

## Core fields by template

- list-page: `projectName`, `entityName`, `title`
- detail-page: `projectName`, `entityName`, `title`
- multi-page: `projectName`, `title`, `pages`

## Clarifying question priority

1. Template type when unclear
2. Project name
3. Entity/pages parameters
4. Must-have behaviors (filters, validation, routing rules)

## Naming defaults

- `projectName`: kebab-case
- `entityName`: PascalCase
- `pages`: comma-separated PascalCase words
